difficulty_reason: The OAuth installation flow is documented and Slack describes creating an app in a development workspace; public distribution and scopes can add requirements.
effort: Create an app in Slack's developer console, set the minimum needed scopes, add an HTTPS redirect URL, and test installation. Marketplace review timing is not established here.
prerequisites: A Slack account and development workspace are needed to create and test an app (confirm current console requirements).
An HTTPS redirect URL is required for OAuth.

steps.title: Create a Slack app
steps.instruction: Create an app and select a development workspace. The app is not created by OAuth Path.

steps.title: Choose permissions
steps.instruction: Request only the bot or user scopes your integration needs. Avoid mixing Sign in with Slack scopes and regular app scopes in one flow.

steps.title: Set the redirect URL
steps.instruction: Add an HTTPS redirect URL in OAuth & Permissions. Ensure the runtime redirect URI matches the configured URL rules.

steps.title: Test installation
steps.instruction: Install to a development workspace and confirm the requested scopes and callback handling.

approval.review_needed: UNCERTAIN for your distribution plan. Slack documents app distribution and marketplace features, but this guide does not establish a general review requirement.
approval.triggers: Marketplace listing or particular scopes/features may have additional requirements; confirm in the current Slack console.
approval.slow_factors: No reliable review timeline was found in the cited OAuth setup page.

blockers.fix: Use HTTPS and make the callback match the configured redirect URL rules. Keep the URI consistent during authorization and token exchange.
Check scope spelling and avoid combining incompatible Sign in with Slack scopes with regular app scopes.

scopes.name: Requested OAuth scopes
scopes.why: Scopes define the access granted. Request only the minimum needed and check whether a scope has additional restrictions.

redirect_rules: Slack's OAuth docs require HTTPS. A requested redirect URI must match or be a subdirectory of a configured redirect URL; fragments are not allowed.
agent_handoff: An agent can read the public docs, draft scope and redirect settings, and help debug errors. A human must sign in, create the app, choose its workspace, manage secrets, and submit any provider review.
next_action: Open Slack's app console and create a development app so you can inspect its OAuth & Permissions settings.
